## Workflow C · Notify matched users
Called by Workflow B when matching is done. Builds one personalised email per user with new matches and sends it with the **AWS SES** node.

**Safety:** emails never go to the CSV's addresses. Every message is redirected to the test inboxes in `TEST_INBOX_ALIASES` (e.g. you+one@gmail.com), and at most `MAX_EMAILS_PER_RUN` are sent (SES sandbox: 200/day, 1/second).

A match is marked `notified_at` only after SES accepted the email, so a failed send is retried on the next run.

parameters.query: SELECT batch_id FROM upload_batches WHERE status IN ('matched', 'notified') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

-- One row per user with un-emailed matches in this batch; their products as JSON, best rate first.
SELECT $1::uuid AS batch_id, u.user_id, u.name, u.email AS original_email,
       u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status,
       json_agg(json_build_object(
         'lender', p.lender, 'product', p.product_name,
         'rate_min', p.interest_rate_min, 'rate_max', p.interest_rate_max,
         'reason', m.reason, 'url', p.source_url)
         ORDER BY p.interest_rate_min NULLS LAST, p.lender) AS products,
       json_agg(m.match_id) AS match_ids
FROM matches m
JOIN users u USING (user_id)
JOIN loan_products p USING (product_id)
WHERE m.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.notified_at IS NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, u.name
LIMIT $2::int

UPDATE matches SET notified_at = now()
WHERE match_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)::bigint)
RETURNING match_id

UPDATE upload_batches b
SET status = 'notified', updated_at = now(),
    stats = stats || jsonb_build_object('notify', jsonb_build_object(
      'users_with_matches', (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM matches WHERE batch_id = b.batch_id),
      'users_emailed',      (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM matches WHERE batch_id = b.batch_id AND notified_at IS NOT NULL),
      'email_cap_per_run',  $2::int))
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id, stats -> 'notify' AS notify
